title: Wanderings in South America
author: Charles Waterton
description: "Wanderings in South America" by Charles Waterton is an exploratory narrative written in the early 19th century.
longDescription: The work details the author's travels in the largely untamed landscapes of South America, particularly focusing on his journey through what was then Dutch Guiana.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Waterton (1782–1865) wrote Wanderings in South America. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
